threads.body: @copilot Update this PR directly to trim the newly added provider-name tests to a few representative compatibility cases. This change only makes existing path rejection explicit for CodeQL; the existing regex already rejects these inputs. Keep the production checks in ReferenceCollector.java unchanged. In muzzle/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/tooling/muzzle/ReferenceCollectorTest.java, reduce the expanded parameter lists rather than exhaustively retesting Java identifier syntax: retain representative valid ordinary, nested-class, and Unicode provider names, and a compact malformed set covering slash, backslash, and double-dot path syntax. Preserve assertions that valid providers load the expected class resource and malformed names fail before provider-class resource lookup. Keep unrelated existing tests unchanged. Run the narrowest relevant formatter and ReferenceCollectorTest validation. Update PR #21249 on its verified head repository open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation and head branch trask-codeql-provider-validation; do not create a replacement PR. Keep any platform-assigned follow-up branch if GitHub creates one; do not rename it or create a replacement branch.

replies.body: Trimmed the test cases as requested while preserving the resource lookup and rejection assertions. Committed as `2ec9a8bf`.
